text:
sam: Heads-up: partner asks for a marketplace migration credit for customers moving off an old SKU (sunset) into our new committed offers. Idea: one-time migration credit equal to 15% of first-year commit, capped at $30k, plus step-down support credits during cutover. Need legal, finance, ops alignment.

lucy: Agree it's valuable for adoption. Suggest tying payout to completed migration checklist (SI sign-off + production traffic validation) to avoid premature payouts.

dan: Billing/ops preference: implement as billing adjustment events with tags: `credit:migration`, `partner:<partner>`, `cap_usd:30000`. Avoid creating temporary SKUs.

tess: From sales: surface migration credit in partner co-sell materials but not the listing headline. Use a CTA: "Ask about migration incentives" to avoid oversell.

sam: Good call. Also propose anti-gaming clause: credit void if customer reduces baseline usage by >30% in the 90 days after migration. Legal draft needed.

lucy: We'll need an evidence package for payouts: SI runbook completion doc, traffic validation snapshot, signed acceptance. Ops can require `evidence_uri` in billing event.

dan: Sample event schema we'll use: {"event_type":"credit_adjust","cust":"C-XXX","offer":"MIGRATE-2026","tag":"migration","amount_usd":15000,"cap_usd":30000,"evidence_uri":"https://..."}. I'll open the PR.

tess: Marketing will include a one-pager for field with example savings math and migration timeline expectations. Keep messaging conservative.

ops-bot: Reminder: checklist: legal clause, finance cap sign-off, billing PR, SI evidence template, partner-approved wording.

sam: Action items: (1) Dan: billing PR + `evidence_uri` requirement (2) Lucy: draft partner coop wording + SI evidence template (3) Tess: field one-pager and co-sell script (4) Sam: loop legal & finance for anti-gaming and revenue treatment. Target: finalize by next Tue so partner pilot can start mid-month.

dan: Will open PR today and ping ops.

lucy: I'll share drafts by EOD.

ops-bot: Event scheduled: Migration credit final review 4623457000.

sam: Thanks team. Locking this thread.
